knowledge.name: Synthetic energy asset inventory
knowledge.detail: Fixed turbine, transformer, pipeline, and generator records provide condition, age, hours, service history, risk, and cost evidence.

knowledge.name: Maintenance rate and planning rules
knowledge.detail: Bundled rates and deterministic rules calculate service budgets, condition bands, priority queues, and modeled failure ordering.

knowledge.name: Locked persona evidence
knowledge.detail: Four demo cases preserve exact asset, date, condition, budget, and draft-queue anchors for repeatable validation.

knowledge.name: Approved production source seams
knowledge.detail: IoT or historian, enterprise asset management, and finance planning connections are documented future seams, not enabled sources.

intelligence_processing.name: Modeled failure-window ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Sorts selected assets by predicted failure date and presents condition, annual failure rate, and last major service evidence.

intelligence_processing.name: Asset condition triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Classifies condition scores as critical, warning, or good and calculates the selected portfolio average without safety authorization.

intelligence_processing.name: Maintenance budget projection
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines major, minor, and inspection rates, applying the documented critical-condition multiplier for non-binding estimates.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft work-order prioritization
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders major service, inspection, and preventive maintenance candidates by condition without creating or dispatching work.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed asset filtering
intelligence_processing.detail: Scopes analysis to an exact synthetic asset ID and returns no invented or substituted record when the identifier is unknown.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable RAPP Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file BasicAgent exposes four deterministic read-only operations through local Brainstem chat and API routes.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files support persona-led previews while the validated agent remains unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-guided evidence responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Plant, reliability, finance, and planning users receive source-backed results, uncertainty, reviewer needs, and no-write limits.

management_reporting.name: Maintenance Forecast
management_reporting.detail: Reports modeled failure order, condition, annual failure rate, predicted date, last service, and engineering review candidates.

management_reporting.name: Asset Health Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports condition status, age, operating hours, replacement cost, and average score as advisory screening only.

management_reporting.name: Maintenance Budget Projection
management_reporting.detail: Reports annual maintenance estimates and replacement context for finance and asset-owner validation before commitment.

management_reporting.name: Work Order Plan
management_reporting.detail: Reports a prioritized draft approval queue with work type, estimate, and target period while creating no work order.

tools.name: AssetMaintenanceForecastAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable single-file Python BasicAgent provides four deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes chat, streaming, health, and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft pilot with four skills and two knowledge files; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from deterministic agent or skill evidence.

tools.name: Approved IoT platform or historian
tools.detail: Future least-privilege source for live telemetry and condition evidence; the packaged pilot has no live connection.

tools.name: Enterprise asset management or CMMS
tools.detail: Future governed source for asset and maintenance records; the current agent cannot create, schedule, or update work.

tools.name: Finance planning system
tools.detail: Future approved source for budget context and review; synthetic estimates do not authorize a financial commitment.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams authorized collaboration
tools.detail: Documented future review seam for authorized collaboration; the current package sends no messages or approvals.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every asset, measurement, date, status, cost, forecast, and recommendation is fictional pilot evidence, not a production fact.

supporting_features.name: Four independently routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Failure forecasting, health triage, budget projection, and draft work planning remain separately callable and reviewable.

supporting_features.name: Explicit safety boundary
supporting_features.detail: Condition screening is not a safety determination or operating authorization, and the agent never directs field work.

supporting_features.name: Human authorization and approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Engineering, asset-owner, finance, and dispatcher reviewers retain decisions; future writes require explicit authorized approval.

supporting_features.name: Read-only work-control boundary
supporting_features.detail: No work order, schedule, crew assignment, dispatch, procurement, financial commitment, or external-system write occurs.

supporting_features.name: Future-write governance
supporting_features.detail: Any later write tool must authenticate, check role and current state, obtain confirmation, handle errors, and append an audit event.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and draft control
supporting_features.detail: Four persona cases passed deterministic and Copilot Studio previews while validated builds remained Draft and unpublished.
